components.column: TOTAL EXPENDITURES FOR BOARD OF EDUCATION
TOTAL EXPENDITURES FOR OFFICE OF SUPERINTENDENT

central_spending.note: Board of education, superintendent office, fiscal services and human resources/personnel. Functional accounts, not a census of employees located in a central-office building. Excludes school administration, instructional supervision and technology. Includes salaries, fixed charges, services and other costs assigned to these functions. Nominal dollars.

components.column: TOTAL EXPENDITURES FOR OFFICE OF THE PRINCIPAL

school_admin_spending.note: School administration, office of the principal. Excludes central functions. Includes salaries, fixed charges, services and other costs assigned to these functions. Nominal dollars.

central_payroll.note: Board of education, superintendent office, fiscal services and human resources/personnel. Functional accounts, not a census of employees located in a central-office building. Excludes school administration, instructional supervision and technology. Salary totals exclude benefits and other fixed charges. Staffing, workload and classification changes can affect payroll totals; these are not individual pay increases.

school_admin_payroll.note: Principal/assistant principal salaries, career payments and other salaries in school administrative offices. Salary totals exclude benefits and other fixed charges. Staffing, workload and classification changes can affect payroll totals; these are not individual pay increases.

admin_payroll.note: Central administrative functions plus school administration (principal offices). Central payroll is a subset, not an additional amount. Salary totals exclude benefits and other fixed charges. Staffing, workload and classification changes can affect payroll totals; these are not individual pay increases.

teacher_payroll.note: Teacher salaries plus career-program payments in regular, alternative, special and career/technical instruction. Excludes other salaries, benefits, adult education and early childhood. Salary totals exclude benefits and other fixed charges. Staffing, workload and classification changes can affect payroll totals; these are not individual pay increases.

admin_spending.note: Table 49, row 120: Support Services – Administration. Reconciles to board, superintendent, school administration, fiscal and human-resources functions. Includes benefits and non-payroll costs. Central administration is included, not additional.

admin_pp.note: Table 49, row 120: Support Services – Administration. Reconciles to board, superintendent, school administration, fiscal and human-resources functions. Includes benefits and non-payroll costs. Central administration is included, not additional. Divided by same-year October 1 enrollment.

history.note: FY13: Memphis City and legacy Shelby County are separate predecessors. FY14: unified Shelby County serves the combined area. FY15 onward: six municipal districts operate separately. Trends and change calculations do not bridge those district-boundary changes.

definitions.central: Board of education, superintendent office, fiscal services and human resources/personnel. Functional accounts, not a census of employees located in a central-office building. Excludes school administration, instructional supervision and technology.
definitions.admin: Central administrative functions plus school administration (principal offices).
definitions.teachers: Teacher salaries plus career-program payments in regular, alternative, special and career/technical instruction. Excludes other salaries, benefits, adult education and early childhood.

notes: The revised PDF reports $13,315,717 in direct and indirect support. The annual categories total $13,315,716.83 using retained workbook cents plus the rounded FY2016 drainage addition, which rounds to the printed total.

FY2016 capital is now $1,347,033: $1,000,000 for the High School Annex plus $347,033 in drainage expenditure. FY2017 drainage remains $695,371.53. The two-year drainage sum is approximately $1,042,405. The earlier $1,045,000 narrative is not substituted for this documented sum.

The PDF capital subtotal is now $2,642,405. It includes FY2026 capital and agrees, after rounding, with the $2,642,404.53 sum of annual entries. The earlier omitted-$250,000 subtotal error is resolved.

The printed direct-transfer footer remains $11,900,381. It matches the original workbook calculation of $11,900,380.52, which counted FY2015 mixed-drink tax twice. Removing that $24,562.22 duplication gives $11,875,818.30 under the original selected-category definition. The added drainage expenditure is excluded from this calculation. The PDF contains no formulas, and this reconciliation is not an independent audit of which items were cash transfers.
FY2018 settlement/OPEB remains blank, whereas the prior schedule listed $230,219. Current totals follow the revised PDF. Whether that installment was paid and its funding source remain unresolved.
Broad support includes services, financing, in-kind support and a $95,000 opportunity-cost valuation. It is not a cash-transfer total or the numerator for district operating spending per pupil.
